falsifier.attacker: Agent B possesses Agent A's exact signed COMMIT receipt, exact action, and one-use code and attempts the action first.
falsifier.failure: Agent B is authorized, or Agent B can burn Agent A's permission merely by presenting the stolen artifacts.
falsifier.success: Agent B is denied before execution and before consumption; Agent A can still execute exactly once; Agent A replay is denied.

invariant: A permission granted to one authority subject must not become authority for another subject merely because the receipt and code traveled.
non_goals: Do not bind authority to provider model identity; model replacement under the same stable authority subject must remain possible.
Do not add ancestry or cascade controls already covered by RUNTIME-CONTRACT-002.
Do not treat a producer-declared subject string as receiver-observed identity.
receiver_rule: Subject binding is created by receiver-owned policy and checked against identity observed by the receiver-owned execution boundary before permission consumption.
